title: Largest Concatenated Number
statement:
Arrange a list of numbers so that, written one after another, they form the largest possible number.

The first line is the count `n`, at least 1. The second line holds `n` whole numbers from 0 to one billion, separated by spaces. Put them in the order that makes the biggest number when you join their digits together, and print that number. The answer can be far too long for any integer type, so build it as text. When every number is 0, print a single `0`, not `000`.

Input:

```text
5
3 30 34 5 9
```

Expected output:

```text
9534330
```

If the first number after sorting is `0`, every number is `0`, so the answer is just `0`.
